message: iam:PermissionsBoundary condition applied to AttachRolePolicy/DetachRolePolicy — those actions don't evaluate this condition key, effectively unconditioned policy attachment

The boundary grants iam:Get* and iam:List* on Resource: *, which includes sensitive IAM enumeration APIs beyond typical operational read access. Recommend replacing wildcards with specific required actions.

The boundary grants s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on Resource: *. S3 is cross-account-capable — this allows reading objects from any S3 bucket in any account. Add resource scoping or account condition.
The permission boundary contains only Allow statements with no explicit Deny for dangerous write operations. An explicit Deny provides defense-in-depth if the boundary is extended.
